knowledge_abstraction.bug_theme: Dtype promotion mismatch in indexed assignment
knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: In-place assignment APIs may perform implicit dtype promotion differently depending on the memory layout of the selected destination view; advanced indexing can trigger paths that do not match explicit cast-then-assign semantics.

risk_dimensions.shape: Advanced indexing selection shape and source broadcasting compatibility
risk_dimensions.dtype: Mismatched source/destination dtype pairs requiring implicit promotion
risk_dimensions.memory: Non-contiguous destination views produced by advanced indexing

failure_mechanism.description: The indexed assignment path may not follow correct dtype promotion semantics when advanced indexing produces a non-contiguous destination view, leading to writes that do not match cast-then-assign behavior.

input_exploration: Vary source and destination dtype pairs across floating, integer, and mixed precision categories
Vary advanced indexing shapes and positions, including list-based selection of rows, columns, or blocks
Vary source broadcasting shapes against the selected destination subset
Test non-contiguous or expanded source/destination views
constraint_awareness: Dtype promotion may occur implicitly during indexed assignment
Advanced list indexing can create non-contiguous destination views
Expected semantics should be equivalent to explicit cast-then-assign
oracle_strategy: Compare assigned values against a reference implementation that casts the source to destination dtype before assignment
Check for incorrect numerical values rather than relying only on crashes or exceptions

transferability.reason: This principle applies to APIs that perform in-place indexed writes or scatter-like assignment with dtype promotion, including copy_, scatter_, and indexed_put. It may not apply to pure out-of-place arithmetic where dtype promotion is handled independently of destination memory layout.

important_considerations: Probe dtype promotion paths for in-place indexed assignment
Use advanced indexing forms that create non-contiguous destination selections
Verify results against explicit dtype conversion before assignment
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that systematically explore dtype pairs, advanced indexing positions, and broadcast-compatible source shapes for in-place indexed assignment APIs. Compare in-place results with a reference implementation that performs an explicit cast to the destination dtype followed by the same indexed assignment.
